_comment: light_requirement:0 disables DynamicLeavesBlock.hasAdequateLight (default 13). Required for the azalea sapling to grow inside lush_caves where skylight is 0; vanilla azalea naturally grows in caves, and Nether trees use the same pattern. Empirically validated: without this field, bonemeal on dtquark:azalea_sapling fails inside the cave despite working at the surface.
